## LLM - Request Validator (RFC-044)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/llm-request-validator

**Input:**
```json
{
  "user_request": "...",
  "domain": { "name": "...", "description": "..." },
  "has_image": true,
  "image_attachments": [
    { "url": "...", "filename": "...", "content_type": "image/jpeg" }
  ]
}
```

**Output:** `{ is_valid, issue_type, response, user_state }`

**Attachments:** Les fichiers joints sont passes au LLM pour valider les requetes de type "scan", "analyse document", etc.

**Analyzable:**
```json
{
  "accepts_image": true,
  "accepts_media": false,
  "output_fields": ["is_valid", "issue_type", "user_state", "response"],
  "domain": "nlp"
}
```
